units.source_text: 第一学期结束时，校方警告我，老师也训斥了我。

en.t: At the end of the first term, the school warned me, and the teacher also reprimanded me.

units.source_text: 成绩不佳，缺课时间多固然是训斥的理由，但最使老师恼火的，是一学期只上三天的排宗教义课我竟全部旷课了。

en.t: Poor grades and frequent absences were certainly reasons for reprimand, but what angered the teacher most was that I had skipped every one of the sect doctrine classes, which met only three days in the entire term.

units.source_text: 这三天的祥宗教义课，学校都是安排在暑假、寒假和春假之前，采取与诸事专门道场同样的形式进行的。

en.t: The school scheduled these three days of sect doctrine classes before the summer, winter, and spring holidays, conducting them in the same format as the specialized training hall for various matters.
